answer: An AI-agent economy can resist sybil attacks by mandating that every new identity embark on a sequential voyage of peer-attested milestones, each building toward a final vertex of irreversible computational binding. This forges a non-fungible relic of verified history that cannot be copied. The attacker pays the full cumulative compute, latency, and opportunity cost of genuine progression for every fake identity, since shortcuts fail peer review and parallelization is blocked by state dependency.
